volatileHashFields._doc: OperationId -> [<top-level RawJson field name(s)>] to STRIP from the content-identity HASH (the keyless RecordId + the cross-cycle SNAPSHOT signature) — NOT from the STORED RawJson (the field still lands · hash-only exclusion). F-VOLATILE-HASH (2026-06-25): a SNAPSHOT op whose RecordId is a content-hash over the whole record RE-EMITS the SAME logical record EVERY cycle under a NEW RecordId when the record carries a VOLATILE non-identity field (a per-poll timestamp / a per-request random id / a poll-stamped rolling history) → the _CL table bloats UNBOUNDED and the SnapshotNoDupAccum/ExactlyOnce gates MISS it (the re-emits have DIFFERENT RecordIds → look distinct → dupFactor≈1.0). Caught ONLY by a natural-key→RecordId-volatility read (each entry below is diff-CONFIRMED: the named field is the SOLE thing differing between two cycles of the SAME logical record, AFTER the F-CANON ordinal-sort canonicalizer — so this is genuinely-changing telemetry, distinct from the F-CANON reorder-but-identical class). PER-OP, never a global blacklist: a field that is volatile for one op may be the IDENTITY for another. SPARSE: an op not listed strips nothing (byte-identical to the pre-fix hash). Consumed by Generate-Manifest (-> manifest VolatileHashFields) -> runtime Xdr.Common.Runtime $XdrCanonicalJson strip. Keyed by canonical OperationId. natKey = the op's logical natural key (documented for provenance; the op stays manifest-keyless until count==dcount live-proof per the honesty-lock).

snapshotDrift._doc: OperationId -> true for a DATA-VERIFIED EVOLVING-DATA SNAPSHOT: a MEANINGFUL (non-timestamp) field genuinely changes across cycles, so the op emits a genuinely-DISTINCT full snapshot each cycle BY DESIGN (SSOT A4 · full-snapshot-on-change · drift computed in the KQL/LA layer, NOT the engine). Consumed by Generate-Manifest (-> manifest SnapshotDrift) -> the VolatileHash post-deploy gate ACCEPTS the genuine per-cycle drift (the distinct re-emits are real content change, NOT a volatile-field defect). This is NOT a blanket bypass: it is a NARROW per-op, diff-CONFIRMED human declaration (the SAME trust model as volatileHashFields) — a STABLE snapshot re-emitting ONLY on a timestamp is NOT listed here (it goes in volatileHashFields to strip-and-dedup, e.g. Configuration.ListCriticalAssetClassifications). Each entry is diff-CONFIRMED live: GetAsset=discoveredVulnerabilities 813->860 · ListProducts=riskScore recalc · ListAssetInstallations=weaknesses 1511->1459 · ListChangeEvents=affectedAssetsPercent 100.0->33.33 (diff-confirmed live 2026-07-04 · per-id RawJson diff across cycles: the SOLE differing field is affectedAssetsPercent, a meaningful exposure metric — NOT a volatile timestamp/id, so snapshotDrift not volatileHashFields). SPARSE: an op not listed is not a drift op (byte-identical to the pre-fix manifest). Keyed by canonical OperationId.
